program.name: HIIT 35
program.subject: HIIT
program.blurb: Thirty-five minutes of no-gear HIIT: an EMOM and Tabatas, or a circuit and a ladder.
program.about: HIIT for about half an hour, no equipment. One day is an EMOM of jumps and strength moves, then Tabatas; the other a circuit, then a ladder of a jump and a push. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III brings harder variations.
